# Journal of Marketing & Social Research

> > A peer-reviewed academic journal publishing cutting-edge research in marketing, social research, and consumer behavior with open access and international editorial standards.

JMSR is an open-access, peer-reviewed journal published by the Asian Society of Management & Marketing Research (ASMMR) based in Coimbatore. The journal follows international publishing standards including ICMJE guidelines, COPE ethics policies, and Creative Commons licensing to advance scholarship in marketing and social research.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://jmsr-online.com): Homepage for JMSR, a peer-reviewed academic journal on marketing and social research
- [Aim & Scope](https://jmsr-online.com/about/aim-and-scope): Journal aims and scope covering marketing, social research, and consumer behavior topics
- [About Editorial Board](https://jmsr-online.com/about/editorial-board): Editorial board members including Dr. M. Dhanabhakyam and academic leadership team
- [Journal Insights](https://jmsr-online.com/insights): Journal insights on peer-reviewed research, publication guidelines, and methodologies

## Submit & Publish

- [Submit Article](https://jmsr-online.com/submit-article): Article submission portal with plagiarism policy and ethical guidelines
- [For Authors](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-authors): Author guidelines, manuscript submission, and formatting instructions for JMSR
- [Peer Review Process](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/peer-review-process): Detailed peer review process, manuscript submission, and authorship criteria
- [Article Processing Charges](https://jmsr-online.com/article-processing-charges): Article processing charges and publication cost information for JMSR authors
- [Articles In-Press](https://jmsr-online.com/articles-in-press): Recently accepted articles in-press awaiting publication

## Policies & Standards

- [For Reviewers](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-reviewers): Peer review guidelines, conflict of interest, and confidentiality policies
- [For Editors](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/for-editors): Editorial guidelines and responsibilities for editors and managing editors
- [Open Access Policy](https://jmsr-online.com/policy/open-access): Open access policy using Creative Commons CC BY licensing model
- [Publication Frequency](https://jmsr-online.com/publication-frequency): Publication frequency and journal policies FAQ for JMSR

## Special Issues

- [Open Special Issues](https://jmsr-online.com/special-issue/open): Currently open special issues with active calls for papers

- [Propose a Special Issue](https://jmsr-online.com/special-issue/propose): Guidelines for proposing special issues with guest editor requirements
- [Published Special Issues](https://jmsr-online.com/special-issue/published): Archive of previously published special issues in marketing and social research
